Here is the recap of your Larchmorrow Strength five-day summer campaign on X, which ran from **Sunday, July 11, 2027 (12:00 AM MDT / 06:00 UTC) through Thursday, July 15, 2027 (11:59 PM MDT / July 16 06:00 UTC)** and is now paused and completed.

### Overall Campaign Summary
* **Total Spend:** **$493.40 USD** (out of your $500.00 total budget)
* **Total Impressions:** **232,531** (reaching **198,903** unique users at an average frequency of **1.17**)
* **Total Link Clicks:** **166** (average cost per link click of **$2.97**, link CTR of **0.071%**)
* **Total Engagements:** **1,627** (including 42 likes, 1 reply, and 1 repost)

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)
All ad groups were restricted to **United States & Canada**, **iOS & Android mobile devices** (`PLATFORM` 0 and 1, excluding desktop, tablets, and mobile web on other devices), and **Age 50+** (the closest upper age bracket available on X, with Optimized Targeting turned off to preserve strict device and demographic boundaries), optimized for **Link Clicks** (`WEBSITE_CLICKS`):

| Line Item | Targeting Focus | Spend | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC | Link CTR |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **US/CA 50+ \| Strength & Home Exercise Keywords** (`kzxtd`) | Broad keywords: *strength workout, home exercise, chair workout, senior fitness, strength over 60* | $305.59 | 115,943 | 104 | $2.94 | 0.090% |
| **US/CA 50+ \| Health & Workouts** (`jpf4n`) | Interests: *Health & Fitness, Workouts, Nutrition* | $117.97 | 41,195 | 33 | $3.57 | 0.080% |
| **US/CA 50+ Broad** (`mqvwx`) | Demographic & Mobile Platform baseline (50+, iOS/Android, US/CA) | $69.84 | 75,393 | 29 | $2.41 | 0.038% |
| **Total** | | **$493.40** | **232,531** | **166** | **$2.97** | **0.071%** |

### Performance by Approved Post
Both approved posts were promoted across all three ad groups:

* **Post `2206282024354198610`** (*"A little strength can fit into a summer day. Larchmorrow Strength offers clear, 12-minute home sessions designed for life after 60. Try the app free for 14 days: https://larchmorrow.com/start"*)
  * **Spend:** $304.22 | **Impressions:** 114,885 | **Link Clicks:** 100 | **Link CTR:** 0.087% | **Avg. CPC:** $3.04
* **Post `2206463218284357170`** (*"Your summer calendar has apparently forgotten to schedule a breather. Got 12 minutes before its next request? Find your free 14-day start: https://larchmorrow.com/start"*)
  * **Spend:** $189.18 | **Impressions:** 117,646 | **Link Clicks:** 66 | **Link CTR:** 0.056% | **Avg. CPC:** $2.87

---

### In-Flight Adjustments Made
1. **Day 1 Pruning of Low-Intent Lifestyle Interests:** Midday on July 11, the keyword ad group (`kzxtd`) was serving impressions primarily on broad lifestyle interests (*Home & Garden* and *Family*) without generating link clicks. Removing those two broad interests so the ad group focused strictly on strength and home-exercise keywords immediately turned `kzxtd` into the strongest driver of link clicks for the rest of the flight.
2. **Budget Reallocation Toward High-Intent Search/Keyword Traffic:** By Day 3, the keyword-targeted ad group (`kzxtd`) was delivering both the highest click volume and the strongest link CTR (0.090%), with Post `2206282024354198610` explicitly calling out *"12-minute home sessions designed for life after 60"* driving the highest click-through rate. We shifted the majority of the remaining budget ($310 cap, $90/day) into `kzxtd` while trimming the lower-CTR broad ad group (`mqvwx`) and higher-CPC general health interest group (`jpf4n`).

---

### What These Figures Show (Measurement Context)
* **Top-of-Funnel Traffic Only:** Because your website (`https://larchmorrow.com/start`) does not have an X conversion pixel installed and there is no mobile app conversion tracking linked to X, **X can only measure ad delivery (232,531 impressions) and outbound clicks to your landing page (166 link clicks).**
* **In-App Trial Starts:** A link click indicates that a user on an iOS or Android device in the US or Canada tapped through to `https://larchmorrow.com/start`, but it does **not** represent an app download or a 14-day free-trial activation. To evaluate how many actual free-trial starts this campaign generated—and your true cost per trial start—please cross-reference your internal in-app reporting for July 11–15, 2027 against the **$493.40** spend and **166** landing-page link clicks reported here.
